videos.title: D.B. Cooper: The Skyjacker Who Vanished Mid-Air | True Crime
videos.description:
On November 24, 1971 — the eve of Thanksgiving — a calm, polite man in a dark suit boarded Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 305 in Portland, Oregon. He called himself Dan Cooper. Within an hour, he handed a flight attendant a note claiming he had a bomb, demanded $200,000 in cash and four parachutes, and set in motion the only unsolved skyjacking in American history.

After releasing 36 passengers in Seattle, Cooper ordered the Boeing 727 back into the stormy night sky. Somewhere over the dark forests of southwestern Washington, he lowered the rear stairs, strapped the money to his body, and jumped into the void — never to be seen again. In 1980, $5,800 of the ransom money was found rotting on the banks of the Columbia River. The rest has never been recovered.

In this documentary, Dark Case Files traces every step of the case: the hijacking, the jump, the massive FBI manhunt, the suspects — including Richard McCoy — and the theories that still divide investigators more than fifty years later. In 2016, the FBI closed the case. The legend of D.B. Cooper only grew.
